subject: Quantix — Security evidence delivery & buying process follow-up
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@quantix.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@quantix.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quantix discovery recap + evidence/timeline next steps

Hi Emily / Liam —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Call recap:
- Use case: quantix.ai will pilot Redwood for real-time recommendation enrichment across web + email workflows.
- Primary decision criteria: latency SLA (p99 target), cost per 1k tokens, and data residency controls.
- Key stakeholders you mentioned: Sophie Lee (economic buyer), Emily (security), Arjun (legal), Liam (procurement).

Open items / evidence you asked for:
1) SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and scope notes
2) Latest pen test summary and remediation status
3) Sample audit logs (redacted) showing auth/events/retention format
4) Data retention policy and encryption/KMS details
5) Procurement steps and required paperwork for PO/contract

Proposed next steps:
- Quantix to share stakeholder contact details and estimated procurement timeline (Liam / Sophie).
- Redwood will prepare an evidence package and upload to the shared Drive by EOD Thu (2026-07-22).
- Marissa / Dylan to schedule a 30m follow-up technical call next week to walk through logs and KMS questions.

If that looks right, I can coordinate the upload and loop in Legal Ops to prepare standard SOW/PO language for review.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

Attachments: evidence-request-checklist.xlsx (template we use)

From: Emily Park <emily.park@quantix.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@quantix.ai>, Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@quantix.ai>, Arjun Rao <arjun.rao@quantix.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quantix discovery recap + evidence/timeline next steps

Thanks Ben — nice summary. Confirming stakeholder mapping here for your tracker: 
- Economic buyer: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@quantix.ai> (VP Product)
- Security lead: Emily Park <emily.park@quantix.ai> (Head of IT Security)
- Legal counsel: Arjun Rao <arjun.rao@quantix.ai>
- Procurement: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@quantix.ai> and procurement@quantix.ai

Procurement timeline: budget approval expected first week of August. Once Sophie signs off on the pilot budget, procurement will start the PO routing — estimate 2 weeks to issue a PO if no redlines.

On evidence: we've uploaded a brief contacts spreadsheet and our procurement template to a shared Drive folder (link below). We generally require:
- SOC 2 Type II report and assertion letter
- Pen test executive summary with date and remediation notes
- A sample of audit logs (redacted) showing login/role changes and API access events
- Data retention policy confirming retention windows and deletion/erasure processes

One question: for audit logs are you able to provide a CSV sample with timestamps in RFC3339 and event types as a header? That will help our SRE validate ingestion.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QxExampleSharedDriveLink

Thanks,
Emily Park
Head of IT Security | Quantix
emily.park@quantix.ai

Attachment: Quantix-org-contacts.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Emily Park <emily.park@quantix.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quantix discovery recap + evidence/timeline next steps

Looping in some technical guidance from the GRC side so we capture exactly what Quantix needs.

Marissa notes:
- Audit logs: include at minimum event_time (RFC3339), user_id, event_type, resource, source_ip, request_id. CSV is fine; sample with 48-72 hours of events will be enough for ingestion validation.
- Pen test: executive summary is acceptable if it includes scope, date, high/med/low findings, and remediation status. Full pentest artifacts can be shared under an NDA if needed.
- SOC 2: provide scope statement and control exceptions; Type II is preferred but Type I can be accepted with add'l controls evidence.
- Retention: state the default retention for logs and user data. Quantix asked specifically about erasure timelines and ability to export/delete customer data.

I'll be available for the technical call — suggest Wed 2026-07-28 10:00 PDT (30m) to walk through sample logs and retention questions. Dylan, can you send a calendar invite?

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Security & GRC Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: evidence-request-template.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@quantix.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@quantix.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Quantix evidence delivery plan and tracking

Emily / Liam —

Per Marissa's notes, we assembled the evidence package and are uploading the initial deliverables to the shared Drive now. Deliverables included in this upload:
- SOC2-report-2025.pdf (SOC 2 Type II, scope: infra + services)
- pen_test_summary.pdf (third-party exec summary, May 2026)
- audit-logs-sample.csv (48-hour sample, RFC3339 timestamps, redacted IDs)
- data-retention-faq.pdf (answers to common retention/export requests)

Action items:
- Quantix to confirm that the CSV schema works for ingestion and that the pen test summary satisfies the security team.
- If additional items are required (full pentest under NDA, KMS specifics), Marissa can supply a follow-up technical package.
- We'll also prepare a draft SOW/PO template and share a DocuSign link for signatures if you want to accelerate the pilot.

Target delivery: full package uploaded by 2026-07-22 EOD. Please confirm receipt.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments uploaded: SOC2-report-2025.pdf, pen_test_summary.pdf, audit-logs-sample.csv

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@quantix.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@quantix.ai>, procurement@quantix.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quantix evidence delivery plan and tracking

Ben / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement has confirmed receipt of the SOC 2, pen test summary, and the audit logs sample in the shared Drive. Initial review looks good — security is OK with the exec summary and the sample CSV schema is acceptable. A few follow-ups before we proceed to PO: 

1) Retention confirmation: please confirm default log retention period and whether we can configure 90 vs 180 days per project. Our compliance team typically requires 180 days for production workloads.
2) KMS: confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for storage encryption and whether key rotation is documented.
3) Procurement paperwork: please send your standard SOW/PO template and a DocuSign link for signature routing. We'll aim to issue a PO within 10 business days after Sophie signs the pilot budget.

I've attached our PO-template.docx for reference and looped in Sophie for final signoff. Once we have the KMS and retention answers, procurement can proceed.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Procurement Manager | Quantix
liam.oconnor@quantix.ai

Attachment: PO-template.docx
